You can use 70+ Adobe tools without leaving ChatGPT now – here’s how
Adobe's new plugin works both in Work and Codex, and is available today in ChatGPT.
Radhika Rajkumar
Senior Editor
Radhika Rajkumar is a senior editor at ZDNET based in New York City.…
Read full bio
Radhika Rajkumar
Senior Editor
Read full bio
August 6, 2026, 1:00 pm ET
2 min read
Elyse Betters Picaro / ZDNET
Follow ZDNET:
Add us as a preferred source
on Google.
ZDNET’s key takeaways
Adobe’s new plugin for ChatGPT puts the company’s tools directly in Work and Codex.
Design software must adapt around competitive AI products.
The SaaSpocalypse still hasn’t arrived.
Adobe is expanding its partnership with OpenAI’s
ChatGPT
through a new integration: an
Adobe for ChatGPT plugin
.
The new tool lets users access Adobe-quality creative tools via the interface many have become accustomed to for everything from search to coding. The plugin works in both
Work
and
Codex
, and is available today in the ChatGPT web and app.
More from ZDNET
Also:
I loved ChatGPT Desktop until OpenAI gutted it to make room for Codex and Work
“Drawing on more than 70 tools across Adobe’s creative and productivity suites, the Adobe plugin in ChatGPT supports a wide range of workflows, from editing photos and creating campaign videos to designing marketing assets and generating polished PDFs — all through rich, interactive experiences right in the flow of the conversation,” Adobe said in the release.
While ZDNET has yet to test the plugin, Adobe said it unifies and builds on the company’s existing ChatGPT apps, which include Photoshop, Express, and Acrobat. Adobe
made these apps available for free in ChatGPT
in December, marrying the ease of conversational instruction users have come to expect with the sophistication and specificity of Adobe’s tools, much of which AI image tools can’t match yet.
The plugin aims to keep design-related tasks, such as resizing social videos or turning data into infographics, within a single interface without sacrificing access to Adobe’s tools. An Adobe spokesperson clarified to ZDNET that some of the company’s suite of tools will be available to everyone via the plugin, but that others will be dependent on a user’s Adobe account. Free account holders, for example, will have usage limits.
Also:
I asked ChatGPT Images 2.0 to redesign my app UIs – and wow
“When you want advanced editing, creative control or pixel-level precision, you can continue your work in Adobe’s apps right where you left off,” Adobe’s announcement added. Inside its ecosystem of products, Adobe also has its own
AI assistants
, which live in Photoshop, Express, and Firefly to help with conversational edits and tasks. Adobe also has integrations with
Anthropic’s Claude
and
Microsoft Copilot
.
A changing design market
As AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic continue to release AI-powered design tools, legacy creative software companies are figuring out where they fit. Given the copyright concerns many businesses have over AI-generated images and video, Adobe’s
licensed training data
and ability to restrict tools to a company’s IP position its technology as a commercially safer option.
An Adobe employee told ZDNET on background that licensed training data still seems to matter to enterprise clients, but that the issue is also not very relevant, as tools like Claude Design haven’t emerged as a major competitor yet. They added that while Adobe staff do use some Claude tools internally, Claude Design isn’t one of them.
Also:
I let ChatGPT Work and Claude Cowork loose on my files – only one made me nervous
Overall, Adobe’s expertise in creative software appears to be keeping the business afloat. Despite
market valuations dipping
over
concerns that AI labs will make SaaS extinct
, the company continues to report
strong earnings
each quarter. The Adobe employee added that while stock fluctuations are causing some discomfort internally, morale remains high — and the plugin is further evidence that labs like OpenAI still need what Adobe has to offer.

Introducing Adobe for ChatGPT: Create, edit and get work done — all in ChatGPT
Introducing Adobe for ChatGPT: Create, edit and get work done — all in ChatGPT
The Adobe plugin in ChatGPT brings Adobe’s pro-grade creative and productivity tools together, helping you move from idea to high-quality content in one conversation.
If you're one of the hundreds of millions of people or two million businesses using ChatGPT to brainstorm, research and solve problems, you can now take those conversations further — creating high-quality images, videos, designs and documents.
Today, we’re introducing the
Adobe plugin in ChatGPT
, bringing Adobe’s pro-grade tools for creativity and productivity together in a single unified plugin that works across ChatGPT Work and Codex. Simply activate the Adobe plugin, describe what you want to create, and it automatically brings together the right Adobe tools behind the scenes to get you there. Drawing on more than 70 tools across Adobe’s creative and productivity suites, the Adobe plugin in ChatGPT supports a wide range of workflows, from editing photos and creating campaign videos to designing marketing assets and generating polished PDFs — all through rich, interactive experiences right in the flow of the conversation. That breadth of capabilities means the plugin can adapt to the needs of your project, and when you want advanced editing, creative control or pixel-level precision, you can continue your work in Adobe’s apps right where you left off.
"We're building ChatGPT to connect our users with the best capabilities for the task at hand. Adobe's category-leading creative and productivity tools help people express their creativity, communicate and be more productive, and we're excited to expand our partnership with Adobe to bring those capabilities into ChatGPT with the Adobe plugin in ChatGPT.”
–
Vibhor Chhabra, product lead for ChatGPT Ecosystem, OpenAI
What you can create with the Adobe plugin in ChatGPT
The Adobe plugin in ChatGPT brings together tools from our
previously released
Adobe apps for ChatGPT, along with additional tools and capabilities across
Adobe Express
,
Photoshop
,
Firefly
,
Premiere
,
Acrobat
,
Lightroom
,
Illustrator
,
InDesign
,
Stock
and more. One unified Adobe plugin now takes you from idea to finished work in a single connected experience in ChatGPT.
https://video.tv.adobe.com/v/3496703
Create high-quality creative for your campaign:
Upload your campaign photos and describe the look you want. The Adobe plugin applies a consistent style across the entire set, saves the finished assets to Creative Cloud and transforms your strongest image into a product or packaging mockup.
Turn long-form videos into eye-catching content for your favorite social media platforms.
Create eye-catching video for every social platform:
Turn a long-form video into an eye-catching highlight reel, then adapt it for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and other social platforms.
Find the right template, customize it, then publish it anywhere.
Create a design and share it anywhere:
Browse thousands of design templates with interactive previews, select the best one for your project, customize the copy and colors, then animate it for social media or convert it into a polished PDF that's ready to share or print.
Transform data into customer-ready documents:
Upload a spreadsheet or dataset and describe the result you need. The Adobe plugin transforms your information into professionally formatted PDFs, including event badges, catalogs, infographics and other customer-ready documents.
What makes the Adobe plugin in ChatGPT different
Over the past few months, we’ve expanded access to Adobe’s tools across leading AI chatbot platforms, including ChatGPT,
Claude
and Copilot, with Slack and Gemini coming soon. The Adobe plugin in ChatGPT builds on that work by bringing the power of our creative and productivity apps together in one unified plugin that draws on the same tools and capabilities that power our own agents in Adobe apps. That means you're creating with the same trusted pro-grade tools that creative professionals and digital workers use every day, backed by Adobe's expansive creative and productivity app ecosystem, the only one with the breadth and depth to support end-to-end creative and document productivity workflows.
How to get started with the Adobe plugin in ChatGPT
Open ChatGPT, go to Plugins, and add the Adobe plugin.
Start a new chat, then type “@Adobe” and select Adobe from the menu or use the “+” button to choose it from your installed plugins.
Continue as a guest or sign in with your Adobe account for an even richer experience.
You can start creating immediately as a guest using a broad set of Adobe tools. Sign in with your Adobe account to unlock generative capabilities, access your Creative Cloud files, and save your work across sessions, making it even easier to pick up where you left off in ChatGPT.
Push your ideas even further in Adobe’s apps
The Adobe plugin in ChatGPT is designed to meet you where you’re already working, making it easy to move from ideas to high-quality content inside ChatGPT. When your project calls for deeper creative exploration, advanced editing or pixel-level precision and control, Adobe’s apps are where you can push your ideas even further. For example, you might batch edit a set of product photos in ChatGPT with the Adobe plugin, then open your hero image in Photoshop to explore different creative directions, composite multiple assets, refine every detail with layers and masks, and perfect the final image.
Start creating with the Adobe plugin in ChatGPT today
The
Adobe plugin in ChatGPT
is available globally starting today on ChatGPT web and app. As we learn from how you're using the Adobe plugin, we'll continue evolving the experience with new creative and productivity tools and capabilities, helping you do even more in ChatGPT and other popular AI chatbot platforms.
